svg.title: Build integration and focused regression additions
svg.desc: CMake and GN compile the module. Six unit regressions and one lit test protect the migration. Existing tidy diagnostics, token-buffer and preamble replay tests are reused rather than duplicated. New coverage preserves zero-check semantics and tests location-less errors; GN/lit additions are in figure 18.
svg.text: Build integration and focused regression additions
CMake and GN compile the module. Six unit regressions and one lit test protect the migration.
// Without tidy checks, NOLINT and WarningsAsErrors don't affect warnings.
Existing tidy diagnostics, token-buffer and preamble replay tests are reused rather than duplicated.
New coverage preserves zero-check semantics and tests location-less errors; GN/lit additions are in figure 18.
Colors follow git diff · unchanged context is gray · arrows map responsibilities, not entire excerpts
